text_block_list.text:
Like always, Хару Урара asks to stop by
the park
to play on our way home.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Now every time you and I hang out, I feel like I have to go to the park!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
I figured enjoying the sunset here would
make this
an extra fun day!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
After saying those words, she looks up
at the late
afternoon sky.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, remember when we played here
together?
That was so much fun.
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
And the first time we came here, I ended
up
falling asleep
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
But now, I've gotten super strong. I don't
feel
sleepy at all! Heehee!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. If you're tired, you can nap
though!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just take it easy! Heehee! Sweet
dreams!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: I close my eyes for a little, and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Are you asleep?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Heehee! Fast asleep, I see! Perfect!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
There's a thousand carrot cakes... raining
from the
sky!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Huh?!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
She's clearly trying to control my
dreams, and I
can't help but chuckle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What?! You weren't asleep?!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Hey! And here I was gonna give you a
piggyback
ride home and everything!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Together? That means you, too! Okay!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Are you... asleep?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: ...Are you asleep now?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: How... about... now?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
If you are asleЭпизод.. I'm gonna give you...
a
piggyback ride...
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's fallen fast asleep
herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You're not tired?! Then count carrots!
It'll make
you sleepy!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: One carrot, two carrots...
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Seven carrots... eight carrots...
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: ...Groooowl...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oops. Looks like I made myself hungry...
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
We decide to head back to the
academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I was actually trying to get you to fall
asleep so I
could give you a piggyback
ride home!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: But I guess I'll have to save that for later!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
I chuckle and think back to the time I
was the one
giving her a piggyback ride.
Time sure flies, and
the greatest
evidence of that is Хару Урара's
growth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even though her stomach rumbles, she
looks
dependable as she promises me a
piggyback one
day. As we head back, I
can sense how reliable
she's become.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her body's gotten heavier than before...
I guess
she's grown a lot since our first
trip to this park.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
